title: Intelligence Requirements (IRs)
markdown:
Intelligence Requirements (IRs) are information requests that help you gain insights into a particular subject over a specified period. IRs guide the collection, analysis, and dissemination of intelligence to support decision-making and threat detection within your organization. For more information, see [Collaborate Intelligence Requirements Documentation](https://techdocs.cyware.com/csap/en/intelligence-requirements-552470.html).

As a member, you can perform the following actions:

*   Retrieve a list of IRs you submitted.
    
*   Retrieve a list of matched alerts for a specified IR ID.
